summary: This Dockerfile creates a Docker image for a Node.js application. It starts with Node.js version 18, copies your application files into the container, installs dependencies, and sets the default command to run your app's main entry point.

explanations.1: FROM pulls a pre-made image (Node.js 18) as the starting point — think of it like inheriting a base operating system that already has Node.js installed.
explanations.2: WORKDIR sets the working directory inside the container to /app, so all future commands run from that location — like opening a folder and making it your current directory.
explanations.3: COPY . . takes everything from your local directory (first dot) and copies it into the container's /app directory (second dot).
explanations.4: RUN npm install executes the npm install command inside the container to download and install all the dependencies listed in your package.json file.
explanations.5: CMD sets the default command that runs when the container starts — in this case, it will run 'node index.js' automatically.
